opening.text: I've been feeling tired, having trouble concentrating, and getting short of breath when I exert myself. I've also been feeling dizzy and getting pain in my fingers or toes. These symptoms started about 3 weeks ago. I have high blood pressure and take enalapril for it. I smoke half a pack of cigarettes a day, and have since I was 20.
